title: Global Hack Week: Open Source
description: A week-long virtual hackathon open to all student developers worldwide. Build open source projects, win prizes, and connect with thousands of hackers.

title: NUS Overseas Colleges Program
description: Live and work in global startup hubs like Silicon Valley, Stockholm, Shanghai, and more. 6-12 month entrepreneurship program combining startup internship with coursework.

title: Lee Kuan Yew Global Business Plan Competition
description: Asia's premier startup competition for student entrepreneurs. Pitch your venture to top VCs and win up to $100,000 in prizes.

title: Singapore International Pre-Graduate Award (SIPGA)
description: Research internship at A*STAR institutes. Work alongside world-class researchers on cutting-edge projects in science and technology.

title: Youth Action Challenge
description: A national platform for youths to co-create solutions to social issues in Singapore. Get mentorship, funding and support to turn your ideas into action.

title: Google Summer of Code 2027
description: Contribute to open source organizations over a 12-week summer program. Receive a stipend and mentorship from experienced open source developers.

title: YMCA Youth Leadership Academy
description: Develop your leadership potential through workshops, community projects, and mentorship from industry leaders. Cohort-based, 3-month program.

title: Hack For Good 2026
description: 48-hour hackathon focused on building tech solutions for social good. Organized with support from local NGOs and government agencies.
eligibility: Open to all, teams of up to 4
